opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant - under £100,000; grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget/project costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance; must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return); must work within the UK or UK Overseas Territories. Applicants must have received neither a grant nor a decline within the past year.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities across a wide range of UK charity sectors including arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums and heritage, welfare, and youth. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million regardless of annual income. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation under Charity Commission guidance with at least one year's accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over for capital/project costs or operating/core costs, considered by the Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest form, which is reviewed on a rolling basis all year round with no deadlines.
